prior_claim_correction.previous_accepted_scope: The 260-ms result remains valid only for a definitions-free warm nested eval whose compiler tier is already present.

diagnosis.trust_state: The shelf catalog and exact copied-image attestation still select WORK_TRUSTED_STAGE after retirement. Allocation history does not invalidate content identity.
diagnosis.fastpath_scope: WORK_TRUSTED_STAGE replaces L65M preflight phases 00-03 with the generated plan and capacity check. It does not bypass the generic commit.
diagnosis.remaining_work: The commit still verifies the staged/source image and re-materializes, patches and republishes the 9,420-byte compiler, its 663 patches and 144 directory entries.

diagnosis.conclusion: The contradiction is not an expired trust discriminator. The previous interpretation confused compile-only time with full reload/commit time.
